item_name: Rothco Mesh Back Army Tactical Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco's Mesh Army Cap has a baseball style look with raised embroidered Army lettering across the front panel.
description: Rothco's Mesh Army Cap has a baseball style look with raised embroidered Army lettering across the front panel. The mesh back tactical cap features 4 mesh panels that are 100% polyester and 2 front panels which are a comfortable cotton. The Army cap has a hook and loop closure for secure fit.
